name: Ferienwohnung Juffinger Hugo
beschreibung:
Quietly perched on a hillside in the scenic Thiersee valley, Ferienwohnung Juffinger Hugo provides a welcoming holiday haven. The well-kept apartment features bright interiors, a well-equipped kitchen, and a balcony with expansive alpine vistas.

Lake Thiersee invites refreshing swims in summer, while hiking paths up Mount Pendling start right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Juffinger Hugo in Thiersee offers cosy living comfort and panoramic mountain views in Kufsteinerland.
